question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.
solution:
The correct answer is '**accurate**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the second sentence, we can observe that the reason why listening is important in the process of business transactions is to make the person gather proper information that is correct in details.
 
• **Accurate**: information, measurements, or predictions, correct in all details or exact.
 
 
• **For eg.- Accurate** information about the illness is essential.
 
 
 
• We will thus use the word '**accurate**' to fill in the blank 2.
 
• Hence, **option 3 **is the correct answer.

So the complete passage is- *Listening plays (1) a significant role in the interactive process of business transactions. It enables a person to gather proper and (2) accurate information so that he can understand the matter with clarity. For this, he should have a positive attitude towards the speaker and the (3) topic. He should also (4) concentrate on what is being spoken and then evaluate it with reference to the (5) context.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
 

 Word
 Meaning
 Example
 
 
 
 

 approximate
 close to the actual, but not completely accurate or exact.
 The **approximate** time of death was 9:00 am.
 
 

 vague
 of uncertain, indefinite, or unclear character or meaning.
 Many patients suffer **vague** symptoms.
 
 

 superficial
 appearing to be true or real only until examined more closely.
 The resemblance between the breeds is **superficial**.
